        # Practice calibration: 3, 8, and 13 mm press yielded about 3.4, 9.3,
        # and 15.1 mm marks. Convert the raster's local width to that press depth.
        press_mm = np.clip((exemplar_width_mm+0.1)/1.17, 3., 12.)
        z = PAPER_Z-press_mm/1000.
        xy = np.asarray([pixel_world(u,v) for u,v in uv])
        path = np.column_stack([xy, z])
        length_mm = float(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(uv, axis=0), axis=1).sum()*MM_PER_PIXEL)
        out.append((path, length_mm))
    return out


def write_main(r):
    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=["side_cam"]).meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    current = now[7:10].copy()
    strokes = target_trajectories()
    total = sum(length for _,length in strokes)
    print(f"Writing {len(strokes)} main-sheet strokes; planned centerline length {total:.1f} mm")
    for index, (path, length_mm) in enumerate(strokes, 1):
        start, end = path[0], path[-1]
        start_hover = np.array([start[0], start[1], 0.14])
        move_air(r, current, start_hover)
        # Contact and settle at the first point. This remains the same single
        # continuous contact as the following along-stroke motion.
        call(r, [start, start], dt=0.5, note=f"stroke {index} press")
        res = call(r, path, dt=0.1, note=f"stroke {index} of 13")
        print(f"  stroke {index:02d}: {length_mm:.1f} mm, {len(path)} targets, "
              f"executed {res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk')} control steps")
        end_hover = np.array([end[0], end[1], 0.14])
        call(r, [end_hover, end_hover], dt=0.5, note=f"stroke {index} lift")
        current = end_hover
    print("Main-sheet trajectory complete:", r.status())


def practice_stroke(r, y, z):
    start = np.array([-.13, y, .14]); end = np.array([-.07, y, .14])
    # Read the current tip to avoid moving laterally while the brush is down.
    current = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=["side_cam"]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], dtype=float)
    move_air(r, current, start)
    press = np.array([-.13,y,z])
    call(r, [press, press], dt=0.5, note="practice press")
    xs = np.linspace(-.13,-.07,31)
    pts = [[x,y,z] for x in xs]
    call(r, pts, dt=0.1, note="practice calibration stroke")
    high = np.array([end[0],end[1],.14])
    call(r, [high,high], dt=0.5, note="practice lift")
    return high


def fresh_calibration(r):
    qstart = np.asarray([0.0,0.3926991,0.0,-1.9634954,0.0,2.3561945,0.7853982])
    actual = r.get_obs(cameras=["side_cam"]).meta["proprio"]["now"]
    p0 = np.asarray(actual[7:10], dtype=float)
    well_hover = np.array([-.1,.16,.14])
    call(r, linear_points(p0, well_hover, step_m=0.05), dt=0.5, note="inspect ink well")
    dip_pre = np.array([INK_XY[0],INK_XY[1],.10])
    dip = np.array([INK_XY[0],INK_XY[1],.024])
    call(r, [dip_pre,dip], dt=0.4, note="dip brush")
    loaded = np.array([INK_XY[0],INK_XY[1],.022])
    call(r, [loaded,loaded,loaded], dt=0.5, note="settle in ink")
    well_hover = np.array([INK_XY[0],INK_XY[1],.14])
    call(r,[well_hover,well_hover],dt=0.5,note="lift from ink")
    # Practice measurements: 8 mm, 3 mm, and 13 mm tuft press depth.
    practice_stroke(r, PRACTICE_CENTER_Y, .012)
    practice_stroke(r, -.213, .017)
    practice_stroke(r, -.158, .007)
    call(r,[well_hover,well_hover],dt=0.5,note="return above ink well")


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--main-only",action="store_true",help="write from the current elevated, already-inked pose")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    r=Robot()
    if not args.main_only:
        fresh_calibration(r)
    write_main(r)
    # Save a clear final record frame without advancing simulated time.
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam","side_cam"],video="frames")
    out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    Image.fromarray(obs.last["canvas_cam"]).save(out/"final_canvas.png")
    print("Saved final canvas; time left",obs.meta.get("time_left_s"))

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
